method_and_limitations.method: This v6 amendment describes the exact table joins and conservation checks already performed in v5: 304 held exact keys joined to 378 retained source-witness records, 343 distinct target-level contact associations and original land/no-water mask fragments; all 240 intervals match the accepted held-original run list.
